title: Azahar 2125.0-rc2: official release candidate
summary: Azahar published 2125.0-rc2 on March 19, 2026. The release record documents an official release candidate for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2125.0-rc2 on March 19, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: Fixed a crash when attempting to create shortcuts in the vanilla build. @OpenSauce04 1889. Fixed a crash when attempting to use still-image camera emulation. @PabloMK7 1892. Fixed Amiibo files failing to load in the vanilla build. @OpenSauce04 1888. Fixed an issue where the emulator could erroneously pause after selecting a file for camera emulation. @OpenSauce04 1894.
